title: pkg/api/ responsibility and DI wiring
answers: Where does the HTTP server get constructed and wired?
How is pkg/api/ started at boot?
body:
pkg/api/ is Grafana's HTTP layer only: routing, auth/RBAC/quota middleware, handlers, DTOs, swagger docs. Domain logic lives in pkg/services/<domain>/; handlers call into services, they don't implement business logic.

`HTTPServer` (pkg/api/http_server.go:125) is a DI container struct with ~90 injected service fields (mostly unexported, package-private) plus `*web.Mux` and `routing.RouteRegister`. Built by `ProvideHTTPServer` (http_server.go:249), a large Wire-provider function wired into the graph at pkg/server/wire_core.go:208.

`HTTPServer` implements `Run(ctx) error` (http_server.go:462) making it a `registry.BackgroundService`, started by pkg/registry/backgroundsvcs/background_services.go:61 — not called directly by pkg/server.Server.
